title: 第14章 千帆之城第13章 冰山王城
content_zh:
凯撒有些无奈地收起羊皮书，这虽然不是特斯瑞姆顶层的密卷，但也是中层的高端炼金知识。
放在任何一个巫术学会里，都足以让那些老家伙抢破头，就连大巫师恐怕也会感兴趣。
心中思索片刻，他又从小宝箱体内拿出一瓶散发着莹莹光辉的魔药，液体在瓶中自行流转：“那我把这个给你，非常稀有的血脉魔药！”
然而中年商贩仅仅瞄了一眼，便自顾自的整理起摊位上的水晶糕点：“不要！”
“为什么？”凯撒神色微微一愣，这家伙简直顽固至极，顶尖的炼金知识不要，现在连稀有的血脉魔药都看不上。
要知道，这是他离开极北疆域的时候，从特斯瑞姆的实验塔楼中顺来的。
放到各大商会至少是千枚纳尔起拍，都够买下几十个这样的摊位了。
商贩看着青年手中的魔药，虽然看起来确实非同寻常，但他眼中却闪过几分畏惧之色：“越厉害的魔药缺陷越大，你拿到灰烬骗骗那些蠢货还行！”
凯撒突然无奈的笑了，难怪北方的猎魔人看不上南方的同行，居然连摆摊的商贩都知道其中的问题。
在北境，哪怕是卖糕点的小商贩，也见过太多服用了劣质魔药后发狂的猎魔人，被城卫军像拖死狗一样从角斗场里拽出来。
最终，他在咕噜袋里再次翻找了片刻，正准备拿出一柄精炼武器抵债时……
“他的纳尔我给了！”
凯撒眉毛微微一挑，只见映入眼帘的是两名从阴影中走来的黑袍人，似乎在暗处站了有一会儿了。
不过，他在刹那间就感知出这是一个老人和年轻女人，两人身上都带着一股淡淡的血腥气，像是刚刚从厮杀中脱身。
其中那名身形佝偻的黑袍男人，直接把一大袋纳尔扔给了商贩，随即指了指摆放的水晶糕点：“还有剩下的，我们全要了。”
中年商贩神色诧异，他掂量着手中的钱袋，估摸着里面至少装了五十枚纳尔，脸上的戒备瞬间化为一团和气：“那行吧！”
然而似乎是凯撒刚刚的态度不错，至少没有像某些猎魔人那样，直接上手抢。
中年商贩在临走时，隐晦的扫过两名黑袍人，眼底深处闪过一抹忌惮之色。
随后他回眸看向青年，双眼不停眨动，那频率快得像是眼皮抽筋：“你的运气不错，看来碰到了两个对你感兴趣的大人。”
“谢了！”凯撒面带笑意的冲商贩点了点头，随即用兽皮把剩下的糕点全部包了起来，仿佛没听懂对方话里藏着的警告。

“唉……”中年商贩看着青年满不在乎的模样，最终也只能无奈的摇了摇头，很快就消失在阴影深处，连摊位都顾不上收拾。
而这时，另一名黑袍女人缓缓来到青年身后，饶有兴致地摩挲着这件特殊的炼金长袍：“你的胆子还真大。”
“我一看见你们，我觉得非常熟悉啊……”凯撒面带笑意的看着两人，随即把一块水晶糕点递给了身旁的女人。
content_en:
Caesar reluctantly put away the parchment. Although this was not the top-level secret volume of Tesrim, it was also the middle-level high-end alchemical knowledge.
If placed in any witchcraft society, it would be enough to make those old guys fight for their heads. Even the great wizards might be interested.
After thinking for a moment, he took out a bottle of gleaming magic potion from the small treasure box. The liquid flowed on its own in the bottle: "Then I will give you this, a very rare blood potion!"
However, the middle-aged vendor only glanced at it and then arranged the crystal pastries on the stall: "No!"
"Why?" Caesar looked slightly stunned. This guy is extremely stubborn. He doesn't need top alchemy knowledge, and now he can't even look down on rare blood potions.
You know, this was brought from the experimental tower of Tesrim when he left the Far North Territory.
For major chambers of commerce, the minimum bidding price is at least a thousand Nar, which is enough to buy dozens of such stalls.
The vendor looked at the potion in the young man's hand. Although it did look extraordinary, a hint of fear flashed in his eyes: "The more powerful the potion, the greater the flaws. You can just get the ashes to deceive those idiots!"
Caesar suddenly smiled helplessly. No wonder the demon hunters in the north looked down upon their counterparts in the south. Even the vendors who set up stalls knew about the problem.
In the North, even small vendors selling cakes have seen too many demon hunters who went crazy after taking inferior potions and were dragged out of the arena like dead dogs by the city guards.
Finally, he rummaged around in the Gulu bag again for a moment, and was about to take out a refined weapon to pay off the debt...
"I gave him his Gnar!"
Caesar raised his eyebrows slightly, and saw two men in black robes walking from the shadows. They seemed to have been standing in the dark for a while.
However, he immediately sensed that they were an old man and a young woman. Both of them had a faint smell of blood, as if they had just escaped from a fight.
Among them, the stooped man in black robes threw a large bag of Nar directly to the vendor, and then pointed to the crystal cakes on display: "There are still some left, we want them all."
The middle-aged merchant looked surprised. He weighed the purse in his hand and estimated that it contained at least fifty Naars. The alertness on his face instantly turned into a kind one: "Okay then!"
However, it seemed that Caesar had a good attitude just now, at least he didn't grab it directly like some demon hunters did.
Before the middle-aged merchant left, he glanced at the two men in black robes vaguely, and a hint of fear flashed deep in his eyes.
Then he looked back at the young man, his eyes blinking constantly as fast as his eyelids cramping: "You are lucky. It seems that you have met two adults who are interested in you."
"Thank you!" Caesar nodded to the vendor with a smile, and then wrapped all the remaining cakes in animal skins, as if he didn't understand the warning hidden in the other party's words.
"Alas..." Looking at the young man's indifferent expression, the middle-aged vendor could only helplessly shake his head and quickly disappeared into the depths of the shadows, not even bothering to clean up the stall.
At this time, another woman in black robe slowly came up behind the young man and stroked this special alchemy robe with great interest: "You are really brave."
"When I saw you, I felt very familiar..." Caesar looked at the two of them with a smile, and then handed a piece of crystal pastry to the woman beside him.
